newsitem.title: LATVIA: RTF, Daugavpils dominate Latvian bourse.
newsitem.headline: RTF, Daugavpils dominate Latvian bourse.

text.p: Stock trade on the Latvian bourse was dominated on Thursday by Riga Transport Fleet (RTF) on the official list and by the Daugavpils chain maker on the secondary market, the stock exchange said.
RTF traded 28,722 lats of shares out of total market turnover of 94,256 lats but it remained stable at one lat.
Fellow official list stock Unibanka turned over 19,327 lats and rose to 2.20 lats from 2.15 lats.
Daugavpils traded a big 33,847 lats and was also stable at 1.15 lats.
The rest of the market was fairly quiet with Kaija fish cannery turning over 3,675 lats and slipping to 1.20 lats from 1.25 lats.
The Rigas Raugs yeast plant traded 2,116 lats and was one santime higher at 1.90 lats while the Kurzeme Lock firm saw turnover of 2,745 lats and added five santimes to 40.
